observed_result: With the resident backend and 600-second per-node limits, 8bit/low completed the checkpoint-controlled review. It was materially slower than the 4bit/low reference in this single replicate.
interpretation_ceiling: This is one stochastic replicate. The 8bit/low and 4bit/low runs selected different projection routes and emitted different estimated thinking-token totals, so the elapsed ratio is an end-to-end observed comparison, not an isolated quantization throughput benchmark. Estimated thinking tokens are a transport/runtime proxy rather than canonical token accounting.
